_comment: Seed guides. Stops reference our OSM-derived data by id (place:<id> from data/places.geojson, pier:<id>, landmark:<id>); no coordinates here. `next` is how you reach the following stop: "walk" or "ferry:<lineId>" (drawn along that line's real route).

summary.tr: Baharat çarşısından Galata'ya, vapurla Asya'ya ve Moda'da gün batımı.
summary.en: From the spice market to Galata, a ferry to Asia and sunset in Moda.

note.tr: Güne baharat ve lokum kokuları arasında başla.
note.en: Start among the spices and Turkish delight.
Walk across the Golden Horn past the fishermen.
Climb the tower for the view over the city.
Hop on the vapur — the gulls will follow.
Watch the sunset from the Moda shore.

summary.tr: Uzun Boğaz turu: iki kıta, üç köprü, Karadeniz'in kapısına kadar.
summary.en: The long Bosphorus tour: two continents, three bridges, up to the Black Sea gate.

note.en: Board the Bosphorus Line at Eminönü.
First stop on the European shore.
Across to Asia — look for the Maiden's Tower.

note.tr: Köprülerin altından geçtikten sonra Kanlıca yoğurdu.
note.en: After passing under the bridges: Kanlıca, famous for its yoghurt.
The strait narrows; the Black Sea is close.

note.tr: Son durak: tepeye yürü, balık ye, dönüş vapurunu bekle.
note.en: Last stop: walk up the hill, eat fish, catch the ferry back.

summary.tr: Sahil boyunca Salacak'a yürü, Kız Kulesi'ne karşı gün batımı, vapurla dönüş.
summary.en: Stroll the shore to Salacak, sunset facing the Maiden's Tower, ferry back.

note.tr: Vapurdan in, sahil boyunca güneye yürü.
note.en: Step off the ferry and walk south along the shore.
The Maiden's Tower right in front of you.

note.tr: Çay al, güneşin tarihi yarımadanın arkasına batışını izle.
note.en: Get a tea and watch the sun set behind the old city.
Cross back by ferry as the lights come on.
Finish with a fish sandwich in Eminönü.
